rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE RESTRUCTURING AND CONDONATION OF UNPAID INTERESTS, PENALTIES, AND SURCHARGES ON LOANS SECURED BY FARMERS, FISHERFOLKS, AND AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRARIAN REFORM, THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE, THE PEOPLE'S CREDIT AND FINANCE CORPORATION, THE COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY, AND THE QUEDAN AND RURAL CREDIT GUARANTEE CORPORATION
rows.title_short: Agrarian And Agricultural Loan Restructuring And Condonation Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to provide farmers, fisherfolks, and agrarian reform beneficiaries the opportunity to regain access to government and commercial credit facilities through the condonation of unpaid interests, and surcharges on their existing loans obtained through government lending programs.
States that condonation shall be limited to cases involving force majeure or market aberration, and shall, in no case be applied to cases resulting from the willful default of the borrower to pay such loans.
States further that accumulated payments of not less than 5% of the loan principal shall have been paid at the time of the application for condonation and that, a graduation process shall be granted a one-time condonation only to encourage borrowing discipline and enhance credit worthiness.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-01-31, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-02-01 and received by the Senate on 2023-02-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT INTEGRATING A COMPREHENSIVE STUDY OF PHILIPPINE HISTORY DURING WORLD WAR II INTO THE HIGHER EDUCATION CURRICULUM
rows.title_short: Integrating A Comprehensive Study Of Philippine History During World War I I Into The Higher Education Curriculum
rows.abstract:
Seeks to highlight the role of national heroes in the historical development of the country and educate the youth on the values of patriotism and nationalism and preserve for posterity the stories on the great struggle and heroism of Filipino soldiers who fought the Japanese occupational forces World War II.
Mandates the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) in close collaboration with the Philippine Veterans Affairs Office-Department of National Defense (PVAO-DND) to develop a program to execute and implement the provisions of this Act.
Encourages all higher education institutions to keep in their libraries adequate books, resources, and references materials on World War II as it transpired in the Philippines.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2022-11-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2022-11-16 and received by the Senate on 2022-11-16
